dict.deleteDescriptionWithCredential: Deleting {provider} removes its configuratie and stored API key.
dict.readOnly: The instellingen document is read-only in this deployment.
dict.conflict: Someone else changed these instellingen while this card was open. Sluit it and reopen to edit the current values.

dict.keyStored: Configured — enter a new value to replace

dict.modelContextInvalid: Context window must be a positive count, like 131072, 256K, or 1M.
dict.modelMaxTokensInvalid: Max uitvoer tokens must be a positive count, like 8192, 64K, or 1M.
dict.advancedHint: Other fields live in instellingen.yaml; edit that section directly.
dict.modelCapacityInvalid: A capacity must be a number, optionally suffixed K or M.
dict.modelDuplicate: Each model ID may appear once.
dict.fetchNeedsBaseUrl: Enter the base URL first, then fetch.
dict.fetchEmpty: The provider listed no modellen. Voeg toe: them by hand.
dict.fetchDescription: These zijn the modellen this provider has beschikbaar. Kies the ones to add.
dict.customRouteHint: Lowercase identifier, starting with a letter, that uniquely naams this provider in requests and as its credential naam.
dict.customRouteInvalid: Start with a lowercase letter; then lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
dict.customRouteTaken: A provider already uses this ID.
dict.customNeedsBaseUrl: A custom provider needs a base URL.
dict.customNeedsModels: A custom provider needs at least one model.
dict.welcomeBody:
DeepSeek Harness 0.1 remains in testing for Harness developers. Many areas need further improvement, and we welcome feedback from the developer community. DeepSeek Harness's core plugins and foundational APIs will continue to evolve rapidly over the coming months.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence with developers around the world, building on open-source, open, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome Harness developers everywhere to join the DSH plugin ecosystem.
